script = '''import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font, Alignment, PatternFill, Border, Side

# Create the order_summary.xlsx
wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Order Summary"

# Headers
headers = ["Order ID", "Status", "Total"]
header_font = Font(bold=True, size=12, color="FFFFFF")
header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="4472C4", end_color="4472C4", fill_type="solid")
header_align = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
thin_border = Border(
    left=Side(style="thin"),
    right=Side(style="thin"),
    top=Side(style="thin"),
    bottom=Side(style="thin")
)

for col_idx, header in enumerate(headers, 1):
    cell = ws.cell(row=1, column=col_idx, value=header)
    cell.font = header_font
    cell.fill = header_fill
    cell.alignment = header_align
    cell.border = thin_border

# Data rows
orders = [
    ("ORD-6C71B1", "Cancelled", 79),
    ("ORD-5B048F", "Confirmed", 108),
]

for row_idx, (order_id, status, total) in enumerate(orders, 2):
    ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=1, value=order_id).border = thin_border
    ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=1).alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

    status_cell = ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=2, value=status)
    status_cell.border = thin_border
    status_cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
    if status == "Cancelled":
        status_cell.font = Font(color="FF0000")
    else:
        status_cell.font = Font(color="008000")

    total_cell = ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=3, value=total)
    total_cell.border = thin_border
    total_cell.number_format = "$#,##0"
    total_cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

# Summary row
ws.cell(row=4, column=2, value="Grand Total").font = Font(bold=True)
ws.cell(row=4, column=2).alignment = Alignment(horizontal="right")
ws.cell(row=4, column=3, value=187).font = Font(bold=True)
ws.cell(row=4, column=3).number_format = "$#,##0"
ws.cell(row=4, column=3).alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

# Column widths
ws.column_dimensions["A"].width = 18
ws.column_dimensions["B"].width = 15
ws.column_dimensions["C"].width = 12

wb.save("order_summary.xlsx")
print("order_summary.xlsx created successfully")
'''
